stories.title: Corporate Earnings Growth Broadens Beyond Tech, Bulls Say
stories.summary: MarketWatch reports that S&P 500 earnings growth is no longer being driven mainly by a handful of tech giants, with other sectors starting to contribute more. That broadening is being framed as good news for stock-market bulls worried the rally has been too narrow.
stories.whyItMatters: Wider earnings participation reduces the market's reliance on mega-cap tech for gains, a key concern for investors worried about concentration risk.

stories.title: Trump Signs Vaccine Executive Order; Airfare Price-Transparency Rule Also Moving
stories.summary: President Trump signed an executive order calling for fewer childhood vaccines and falsely linking shots to autism, per CNBC. Separately, Yahoo Finance reports a related Trump administration proposal that could make it harder for consumers to compare airfares, with a public comment period open on airline pricing rules.
stories.whyItMatters: Both actions reflect a broader White House push to rework federal health and consumer-pricing rules, developments that can move healthcare and airline-related stocks and are worth tracking for regulatory risk.
whatToWatch: Public comment period on the airfare pricing proposal
Reaction from health officials and vaccine makers to the executive order
Potential legal challenges to the vaccine order
questions: How might this affect vaccine-maker stocks?
